name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Carrollton TX

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open site - no perimeter fence, gate, or guard booth. Driveways open directly from the internal industrial-park roads; the front entrance is an open drive (confirmed in 2024-02 and 2025-02 Street View).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Older tilt-up industrial building (~1980s-90s). Dock band with loading canopies along the NE face and SE end; estimated ~20 doors - banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Only a few trailers/box trucks at the SE dock apron; no dedicated trailer drop yard - banded 0-10.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Modest dock apron - holds only 1-2 trucks staging; no deep approach.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs alongside the SE/NE property edge but no spur enters the building - not rail-served.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No dedicated trailer-storage lot; only dock-apron parking.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single mid-size distribution building in a dense Carrollton industrial park.
